response.reason: The three generic structures all condition on opponent_profile axes of goals_for and goals_against (HIGH/MID combinations). The candidate conditions on opponent_profile axis 'possession' (HIGH), which is a structurally distinct profile axis — it is not a rewording of the goals-based axes. The cohort is therefore different: high-possession opponents vs. high-scoring/high-conceding opponents are not the same set of teams. Additionally, the candidate adds a competition=SAME filter and grounds the mechanism in a two-characteristic interaction (Preston's foul/card rate jointly with opponent possession dominance), which none of the generics require. The incremental structure is real: a different profile axis produces a different cohort, and the joint mechanism is not decomposable into either generic alone.
